Simulate panel spatial probit and ordered probit data

Source: R/simulate.R
sim_psprobit.Rd

Draws data from the latent model $$z_t = \rho W z_t + X_t\beta + W X_t\theta + \alpha + u_t, \quad u_t = \lambda M u_t + \varepsilon_t$$ with standard normal regressors. The outcome is binary (cutpoints = NULL) or ordered with cut-points \((0, \kappa_2, \dots, \kappa_{J-1})\).

Usage

sim_psprobit(
  W,
  T,
  beta = c(0, 1, -1),
  rho = 0.5,
  sigma_alpha = 1,
  theta = NULL,
  cutpoints = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  lambda = 0,
  M = NULL,
  gamma = NULL,
  eta = NULL,
  phi = 0,
  df = NULL,
  gamma_z = 0
)

Arguments

W

Spatial weights (N x N), used as given, or a list of T such matrices (time-varying weights, period by period).

T

Number of periods.

beta

Coefficients; the first is the intercept, the others belong to regressors x1, x2, ...

rho

Spatial autoregressive parameter (0 for "slx"/"none").

sigma_alpha

Standard deviation of the random effects (0 for pooled).

theta

Optional Durbin coefficients (one per regressor), giving the effects of \(WX\).

cutpoints

Optional free cut-points \(\kappa_2 < \dots < \kappa_{J-1}\), all positive (the first cut-point is fixed at 0). For example cutpoints = 1 gives \(J = 3\) categories.

seed

Optional seed.

lambda

Spatial error parameter (0 for no spatial error term).

M

Error weights (default W); a matrix or a list of T matrices.

gamma

Optional coefficient(s) of the lagged outcome \(y_{i,t-1}\) (one per category above the first for ordered outcomes), as in psp_dynamic(). The first period is generated without lags.

eta

Optional coefficient(s) of the spatially lagged outcome \((W y_{t-1})_i\).

phi

Spatial parameter of the random effects, \(\alpha = \phi W \alpha + a\) with \(a_i \sim N(0, \sigma_\alpha^2)\) (as for effects = "spatial_random"; needs a single W).

df

Optional degrees of freedom of Student-t latent errors (as for errors = psp_t(df)); normal errors by default.

gamma_z

Coefficient of latent AR(1) dynamics, \(\gamma z_{t-1}\) (as for psp_dynamic(latent = TRUE); no lag in the first period).

Value

A data frame with columns id, time, y and the regressors, with attributes truth (parameters, random effects and latent values) and W (the weights as passed, after psp_weights()).

Examples

W <- psp_weights(rook_weights(3, 3), style = "W")
d <- sim_psprobit(W, T = 2, beta = c(0, 1), rho = 0.3, seed = 1)
head(d)
#>   id time y         x1
#> 1  1    1 0 -0.6264538
#> 2  2    1 1  0.1836433
#> 3  3    1 1 -0.8356286
#> 4  4    1 1  1.5952808
#> 5  5    1 1  0.3295078
#> 6  6    1 0 -0.8204684
